# Padding slots in main build E0F3CCFA: runs of zero words (udf #0) that the compiler put between
# functions to align them. Nothing executes or references them, so mods can put code there.
# Format: address length (bytes). Window 0x817976a8..0x8179f6a8 (32 KB, so even tbz reaches
# across all of them), slots of 16 bytes or more, each right after a ret / b / br.
# Made by tools/find_slots.py; mods check them with nxpatch.verify_slots (--verify-main).
# Who uses which: docs/memory-map.md.
